§16 #1 RESOLVED BY ITS OWN RECOMMENDATION — AND THIS SHEET IS WHY IT COULD NOT STAY OPEN

Plan charges become ledger rows

Batch 1 left this open because no frame in it would have shown one. History is that frame, so it forces the answer. Taken: the wireframes' own "Yes" — the monthly charge renders as a non-editable contract row, filterable, counted in the whisper, with a glance sheet instead of a swipe.

The cheap alternative — no row — makes July's whisper and July's Insights headline give different answers to one question, with no copy anywhere to explain the gap. That is the precise bug class the time-pages work was built to kill, so accepting it here would undo the reason that work exists. Still logged as the owner's call, not mine.

§3.1 · THE FEED · DARK

The plan row, drawn

23 July, 289,00 €, contract well. It reads Plan charge — the type, not the brand — and it is the row that makes the whisper agree with Insights. It cannot be swiped; tapping it opens a glance sheet that says "Set by your plan — open the car to change it."

Three rows carry no money, and each for a different reason

The trip carries 232 km — its ≈costs are a share of money already counted, so putting a euro figure there would double-count the ledger against itself. The reading is not money at all. The milestone is a fact Koi recorded, not a transaction — Insurance renewed names the 412,00 € in its meta precisely so no one mistakes it for a July charge.

The whisper counts fills, not records

"3 fills" is the count a driver actually has a feel for. A month with records but no money reads 4 records alone — never 0,00 €, which would say "spent nothing" when the truth is "nothing here was money".

Archived records are a footer, not a filter

An archived car keeps its whole story one tap away. The footer states the count so the ledger never silently under-reports — and it only appears when an archived car actually has records.

Filter state outlives a tab switch

Chips and car scope are device-local screen state, reset only on cold launch. Leaving a tab resets the stack, not the screen — a filter that vanished on every glance elsewhere would make the sacred ledger read as silently partial.

02 · Swipe, and the states

Two empty states, because they need two different actions. Neither apologises; neither is styled as an error.
§3.5 · SWIPE LEFT
Repsol Tarragona6,9 L/100km · 378 km 35,75 €12 Jul
swipe left ▸
Repsol Tar…
Edit Delete

Edit opens the capture surface prefilled — edits reuse the same surface and save quietly; ceremony is for creation only. Delete is always confirmed and always undoable from its toast.

Milestones and plan charges cannot be swiped — they are read-only projections. Neither can a folded reading: it has no row to swipe.

DELETE · SAYS WHAT ELSE IT COSTS
Delete this fill?
It leaves History and your averages, and the next fill's interval is measured again.
Keep it Delete
Fill deleted. Undo

The confirmation names the second consequence — that the next fill's interval is re-measured — because that is the one a driver would not predict. The toast holds the restore closure for its full six seconds.

EMPTY LEDGER · CARS EXIST, NO RECORDS
Nothing logged yet.
Every fill, service and note you add lands here, newest first.
Log a fill-up

It teaches — "newest first" tells the reader what the screen will become — and offers the single action that fixes it. Ink primary, per sheet 08.

FILTERED TO NOTHING
All Fuel Service
No fuel records in this ledger.
Clear filters

A different state with a different action — which is exactly why it is not folded into the empty ledger. Here the records exist; the filter is hiding them, so the fix is to clear the filter, not to log something.
